name: go-build-cache
body: The Go frontend's shared build-cache handling (`go.apg/gofrontend.applyGoBuildCache`, `goBuildCacheDir`). It points GOCACHE at `<git-common-dir>/apg/facts/go/<cache-key>`; it keeps generated `_testmain` scratch files out of the emitted package file list so cache content stays apart from graph identity.
